description: Matchbox helps you find the right product or tool for a real problem. Describe what you're struggling with in plain language — "I keep forgetting to take my medication," "I need to track expenses across three currencies" — and Matchbox returns specific products matched to your situation, ranked by how well they fit rather than how popular they are. It surfaces lesser-known and newer tools alongside established ones, so you discover options that generic searches and listicles miss.

defaultPrompt: I'm a beginner freelance grant writer - what's the best all-in-one tool?
